### Shared Layer Design Rationale

| Module | Responsibility | Key Exports |
|---|---|---|
| `engine/Renderer.ts` | Scene graph, camera, renderer lifecycle | `createScene()`, `dispose()` |
| `engine/PostProcessing.ts` | Bloom pass tuning (emissive glow, not washout) | `initComposer(renderer)`, `setBloomStrength(n)` |
| `engine/InputManager.ts` | Polling both keyboard and gamepad | `.getAxis2D()`, `.wasPressed(key)`, `.gamepadState` |
| `engine/CameraShake.ts` | Shake intensity accumulation + decay | `.addImpact(velocity, position)`, `.apply(camera)` |
| `engine/HitStop.ts` | Frame freeze on impact | `.trigger(duration)`, `.deltaTime()` returns scaled dt |
| `engine/AudioEngine.ts` | Oscillator-based SFX/music | `.playSfx(type)`, `.playMusic(loop)` |
| `engine/GameLoop.ts` | rAF loop, delta-time accumulator | `.start(updateFn)`, `.stop()`, `.dt` |
| `entities/ObjectPool.ts` | Generic object pool with acquire/release | `class Pool<T>` — `.acquire()`, `.release(obj)` |
| `entities/MeshPool.ts` | InstancedMesh lifecycle, batch updates | `createInstancedMesh(geometry, material, count)` |
| `vfx/ParticleManager.ts` | 500-particle hard cap, burst logic | `.burst(position, count, color)`, `.update(dt)` |
| `vfx/MotionTrails.ts` | Trail rendering for fast movers | `.addEntity(mesh, maxTrailLength)` |
| `vfx/ShockwaveRings.ts` | Expanding emissive ring on impact | `.spawn(position, radius, color)` |
| `vfx/FloatingScoreText.ts` | 3D→screen projection to HTML overlay | `.show(worldPos, score)` |
| `gen/GridGenerator.ts` | Retro-futurism grid floor with neon lines | `createGrid(width, height, cellSize)` |
| `gen/GeometryBuilder.ts` | PBR primitive factories | `buildBox(size, color)`, `buildCylinder(...)` |
| `gen/TextureCanvas.ts` | Canvas2D procedural textures | `createGradientTexture(w, h, colors)` |
| `ui/GlassOverlay.ts` | Glassmorphism HUD DOM manager | `.showPanel(title, content)`, `.hideAll()` |
| `ui/NeonText.ts` | Glowing neon text for score/UI | `.setText(id, value, color)` |

### Compliance Statements

1. **Anti-Lazy Directive:** I will never use `// ... rest of code`, `// TODO`, or placeholder comments in any generated file. Every function is fully implemented and production-ready.
2. **Strict Memory Management:** All geometries, materials, textures, and meshes are explicitly disposed via `.dispose()` on game shutdown and entity removal. No orphaned Three.js objects will persist.
3. **Sequential Output Protocol:** I will follow the three-step protocol exactly — Step 1 (this step), then Step 2 upon your "Begin [Game Name]" command, then Step 3 upon "Plan approved". No files are created in this step.
